decisions.reason: Changing KiCad 3D-model references from machine-local paths to project-relative paths does not alter BOM contents, part numbers, or assembly-readiness policies.
The model-reference path correction does not change the requirement to place a QR code on every board.
Restoring cross-machine 3D-model visibility does not change the JLCPCB component-orientation acceptance condition.
The KiCad library-path correction does not change any JLCPCB account, cart, missing-part, or order-configuration rule.
The source decision concerns portable KiCad 3D-model references and does not add, remove, or modify any required fabrication export file.
Machine-independent 3D-model paths do not affect component availability, sourcing preferences, or connector procurement policies.
Correcting 3D-model references does not change the integrated board connector mounting technology from through-hole.
The KiCad path-portability change has no effect on the lead-free manufacturing requirement.
The source decision changes 3D-model path resolution, not connector-pin silkscreen labels or their location.
Portable 3D-model references do not change the charge-status LED circuit, connector, resistor, or population rules.
The source message does not change enclosure dimensions, accommodations, mounting, airflow, assembly, or retention behavior.
Changing KiCad 3D-model paths does not modify the interboard power topology, connector definitions, or pinout rules.
